operators.name: squeeze_dim
semantics: If x.dim() == 0 or x.size(dim) != 1, return x unchanged (same data, same strides and storage).
If x.size(dim) == 1, return x.as_strided(new_sizes) where new_sizes excludes dimension dim; strides are adjusted accordingly.
This op only wraps shape transformation; no data movement or dtype change.

operators.name: concat_dim

parameters.name: tensors
parameters.shape: list of tensors with all dimensions equal except dim
parameters.layout: list of tensor objects; each must be cuda float32

semantics: Concatenate input tensors along dimension dim.
Output is a new contiguous tensor with shape equal to sum of sizes along dim and equal other dimensions.
Equivalent to torch.cat(tensors, dim=dim) for float32 CUDA tensors.
If x1.size(squeeze_dim) == 1, remove dimension squeeze_dim; else x1 unchanged.
In this task, input size along dim 1 is 8, so no change.
If x2.size(squeeze_dim) == 1, remove dimension squeeze_dim; else x2 unchanged.
In this task, input size along dim 1 is 8, so no change.
Concatenate the two squeezed tensors along dimension squeeze_dim.
